structuredContent.body:
The endpoint law alone could not condition arbitrary field-dependent events. This extension constructs the actual smooth-coefficient carrier’s canonical conditional kernel, every-pin support and physical endpoint compatibility, then derives its literal determinant-weighted whole-carrier probability and event transfer from nonzero period L and fixed height b. It also proves weighted Gaussian-series moments/exponential bounds and actual conditional derivative-majorant moments and tails.

Frozen mathematical source cut `37f8f01db8b7e30190f09bf784d1b4e3419da540` contains four qualified additions: SourceSmoothConditionalKernel, SourceSmoothPalm, GaussianWeightedMajorants and SourceConditionalMajorant. The combined packet has18 modules/292 registered declarations and23 support inputs. The new four-module scope has109 direct audit targets plus one disclosed probability instance covered through printed parents. Each new module’s compile, named kernel, standard-axiom census and meaningful controls passed; genuine failures and metadata limits remain preserved. Applicable fourteen-module prerequisite verification was reused.

Different-family scientific CODE-ALIGNMENT review by Anthropic Claude01CZ passed at the exact frozen source cut: comment6405469445. That scope covers the actual whole-field conditional and weighted laws/moments; it is not broadened into a geometric Palm, capture or parent theorem.

Author head is now `c0c92e7241f6ed41770b0fb6896b483d1c2ed2b0`, a normal source-preserving two-parent merge of the frozen source with actual Math main `1cba5115253d43e1e46caa7e0381fcb3f6108cbd`. No conflicts or manual resolution. Entire packet tree `aa776f39937e40b7aff96471aa097e7a566d8a9a` and fixed inputs are unchanged. All13 incoming paths are already-landed base history; authored workflow diff versus main is empty. Existing source/hypothesis/dependency verification is reused, not rerun.

Actual separate nonauthor engineering composition COMMENT review5647406155 passed this exact head. It supplies engineering preservation evidence, zero new scientific/provider-distinct credit. Current required hosted jobs passed on the tested merge `f247c2232704b6494d8a008aa986a418d15f3999`, whose tree `cf3e699e9deb25a7ce1b12b92b1c2f50dd3ba82f` equals the author-head tree. Automatic review, findings disposition and separate guarded integration remain distinct duties.

Successor#514 contains the later curvature, raw-pin, Morse, topology, Lifetime and conventional parent applications under their own scopes/reviews. This PR alone makes no geometric Palm/elder/counting/P0.2 or parent-closure claim. The PR512 unintended-merge process incident remains an open owner/CoS matter; this branch refresh neither waives nor decides it. Scientific effect NONE.
